```python
class Attribution:
    def __init__(self, spans):
        self.spans = spans   # (start, end, label) with end>start only
        self.starts = [sp[0] for sp in spans]
        self.cursor = 0
    def owners(self, s, e):
        spans = self.spans
        i = bisect_right(self.starts, s) - 1
        if i < 0: i = 0
        out = []
        while i < len(spans) and spans[i][0] < e:
            a, b, label = spans[i]
            lo = a if a > s else s
            hi = b if b < e else e
            if hi > lo:
                if out and out[-1][0] == label:
                    out[-1][1] += hi - lo
                else:
                    out.append([label, hi-lo])
            i += 1
        return out
```
